Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.api.v3.dataslices

Class ImportDataSlice.CustomParams

java.lang.Object
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.api.v3.dataslices.ImportDataSlice.CustomParams
Enclosing class:
ImportDataSlice
public static class ImportDataSlice.CustomParams extends Object
Additional, non-standard parameters accepted by the "import data slice" endpoint, controlling post-import rule execution and how rejected cells are reported.
